tasks.title: Halt the run with exit 2 when the gate verdict holds a check-gap finding, keeping nothing
tasks.goal: Only the operator can add a check to .vloop/config.toml, so sending a check-gap back to the planner spends a round on something it cannot fix. When any round's gate verdict has a check-gap, the driver prints every finding as today and halts with exit 2 before any work, committing nothing and leaving no plan, so the re-run plans afresh with the new check in its checks. A verdict without a check-gap must behave exactly as today.

references.why: reads the gate verdict and turns findings into problems; it must validate gate-verdict/v2 and is where the check-gap decision is made

acceptPlan's rounds and what a plan that is not fit leaves behind (no state.json, no gate folders, nothing committed) — the state the halt must leave; the existing "failed the plan twice" path stays as it is for verdicts without a check-gap
R-3: the halt reuses exit 2 (blocked); no new exit code
the shape the driver read so far; it now reads gate-verdict/v2, and v1 stays unchanged

acceptance: The driver validates the session's .vloop/tmp/gate-verdict.json as gate-verdict/v2

When a gate verdict has any check-gap finding, in any round, the run prints every finding of the verdict as it does today (gate <task> (<kind>): <summary>), then ends with exit 2 and the line: vloop: the gate review found <n> check gap(s): the plan needs a check .vloop/config.toml does not have — add it, commit it, then re-run (see <run folder>reports/gate-review-<round>.json), where <n> counts the check-gap findings and <run folder> is repo-relative

The check-gap halt sends nothing back to the plan session (no revision round), runs no work session, commits nothing on any branch and leaves no .vloop/state/state.json, gate folders or plan.md behind; the report it names exists
A check-gap in round 2 halts with the check-gap line naming gate-review-2.json, not with "the gate review failed the plan twice"
A verdict with no check-gap behaves exactly as today: uncovered and every other kind are sent back to the planner, and a second FAIL blocks the plan with "the gate review failed the plan twice"
A re-run after the halt plans afresh (a new plan session, not "resuming acceptance")
The task leaves committed tests the go check runs, covering the check-gap halt (round 1 and round 2, alone and beside another finding) and an uncovered finding being sent back

P-8 is cited, not restated, and the gate-review-coverage eval case is the behaviour's proof, since gates never run claude.
